newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Taipan sees Gawler Craton exploration.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Taipan sees Gawler Craton exploration.

text.p: Gold explorer Taipan Resources NL said on Monday it had applied for five exploration licences in the highly prospective Gawler Craton region of South Australia.
Taipan said the application covered an area of 8,718 square kilometres, including one prospect at Lake Everard which is 35 kilometres southeast of the Tunkillia project held by Helix Resources NL.
The company said it was the first company to apply for the licence and under the state's mining law it may share priority with one other applicant. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
